# plot_aromatic_rings { #mofography.visualize.plot_aromatic_rings }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Plotly traces for aromatic ring outlines and fills; paired with compute_aromatic_cycles.

```python
visualize.plot_aromatic_rings(
    ase_atoms,
    isomorphic_aromatic_cycles=None,
    kwargs_rings=dict(mode='lines', line=(dict(color='white', width=2)), showlegend=False, legendgroup='aromatics', legendgrouptitle_text='Aromatic rings', name='Aromatic rings'),
    kwargs_highlight=dict(color='skyblue', opacity=0.5, alphahull=(-1), showlegend=False, legendgroup='aromatics', legendgrouptitle_text='Aromatic rings', name='Aromatic highlights'),
)
```

Plotly traces for aromatic ring outlines and semi-transparent fills.

When ``isomorphic_aromatic_cycles`` is ``None``, calls
:func:`~mofography.analyze.compute_aromatic_cycles` (same path as Three.js;
cached on ``ase_atoms.info["aromatic_cycles"]``).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                       | Type   | Description                                  | Default   |
|----------------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| isomorphic_aromatic_cycles |        | atom-index rings, or ``None`` to auto-detect | `None`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------|
|        |        | tuple of outline + highlight Plotly traces |
